critical_code_review_comments: mart_catalog_routes.create_product wraps ANY SQLAlchemy exception as 409 with the raw exception string in the detail — this can leak internal SQL/table info to admins. Consider narrowing to IntegrityError only and returning a sanitised message.

PartnerInventory row is lazily materialised inside GET /partner/inventory (writes on read). This is convenient but under concurrent first-time reads two writers could both insert the row leading to a duplicate. A unique constraint on (partner_id, partner_product_id, warehouse_id) plus catch/rollback would harden this, otherwise fine.
list_inventory returns floats/ints for qty but the response model isn't declared — consider Pydantic response_model for stable API contracts.

delete_brand silently unlinks products (sets brand_id=NULL). This is intentional per the docstring but audit log entry ('mart.brand.delete') doesn't record how many products were unlinked — could be useful metadata to store.
